name: Sora Takahashi
summary: Marine Conservation Program Manager in Honolulu coordinating inter-island coral bleaching surveys across Oʻahu, Maui, and Kauaʻi, balancing offshore 4-6 day boat blackouts, non-DST Pacific/Honolulu scheduling, Unicode/diacritic/CJK notes, recurring missed-run automations, and two teenagers.

initial_permissions.title: Read work emails, calendar, and field docs

persona_responder_brief: You are Sora Takahashi, a 45-year-old Marine Conservation Program Manager at Pacific Reef Initiative in Honolulu (Pacific/Honolulu, no DST). Write warmly, calmly, and concisely with accurate Hawaiian diacritics (Kāneʻohe, Oʻahu, Kauaʻi, Hōkūleʻa, Mālama, Nākānelua), occasional Japanese terms (kaizen, obento, 珊瑚), and light ocean emojis. Never auto-approve outbound NOAA emails without checking numbers first; always protect Tue/Thu 5:30 AM Hōkūleʻa outrigger canoe practice (no meetings before 8:00 AM Tue/Thu).

emails.subject: FY2027 Coral Resilience Grant & Permit #HI-CR-2027-0418 Timeline
emails.body:
Aloha Sora,

Happy New Year! Quick reminder that our FY2027 Coral Resilience Grant package ($184,500 request) is due February 5, 2027. For Permit #HI-CR-2027-0418 renewal, please share your winter bleaching baselines for Kāneʻohe Bay, Honolua Bay, and Hanalei Bay once you wrap your January dives.

Let's also lock in a check-in call next Thursday (Jan 14) at 11:00 AM Seattle time.

Mahalo,
Dr. Elena Reyes-Vega
NOAA PIRO

emails.subject: R/V Makani Kai — Maui (Honolua Bay) departure Jan 9
emails.body:
Aloha Sora & Kaiulani,

Tanks are filled and R/V Makani Kai is fueled at Heʻeia Kea Boat Harbor. Trade winds look clean for our Saturday Jan 9 departure to Honolua Bay, Maui, returning Wednesday Jan 13 late afternoon. Remember we'll be off-grid with zero cell reception once we clear Molokaʻi channel.

Capt. Keoni Kaleikini

emails.subject: Aloha Bots — Electrical Inspection & Mainland Crate Schedule
emails.body:
Hi Aloha Bots parents,

Mei has been crushing the wiring harness! Saturday Jan 16 is our electrical inspection build day (thank you Sora for volunteering obento snacks). Right now our Matson freight crate shipping cutoff for mainland nationals is February 12, though I'll email if the carrier shifts the window.

Mahalo,
Coach Marcus Ching

docs.title: Pacific Reef Initiative — 2027 Inter-Island Dive Safety Protocol
docs.content: Lead Diver: Kaiulani Nākānelua. Vessel Captain: Keoni Kaleikini (R/V Makani Kai). All benthic transects require buddy check, backup HOBO thermistor readout, zero anchoring on live coral (Mālama i ke kai), and Dr. Kenji Sato's kaizen color-card calibration for 珊瑚 bleaching scores.

docs.title: Kai Takahashi — Hawaiʻi Learner's Permit Supervised Driving Log
docs.content: Required for June 2027 road test: 50 total supervised hours (40 daytime + 10 nighttime). As of Jan 3, 2027: 14.5 daytime hours, 2.0 nighttime hours (16.5 total).
